note: Three paper user test sheets from 18 September 2026, transcribed. Testers are numbered, never named. Where a tester wrote 'same' and left the Pass box empty, the card is recorded as a pass; where they wrote 'same but', as a fail. Bug severities were not ticked on any sheet, so they are unset and the teacher can place them. Imported with scripts/import-test-sheets.ts.
